# Amazon KDP listing – My Big Tracing Day (paperback)

**Title:** My Big Tracing Day
**Subtitle:** A Colourful Tracing Book for Ages 2–4: Trace Lines, Shapes, Paths, Numbers 1–10 and Letters A–Z with Mia, Leo and Kai
**Author / publisher name:** Little Worlds Learning (the name on your KDP account)
**Reading age:** 2–4 years · **Language:** English

## Description
<b>Spend a whole bright, happy day tracing with three toddler friends!</b>
From wake-up stretches to bedtime stories, little hands trace big, friendly dotted lines on 78 colourful pages.
<ul>
<li>Morning Lines – 12 warm-up line pages</li>
<li>Breakfast Shapes – 10 shape pages</li>
<li>Park Paths – 8 follow-the-path pages</li>
<li>Bath-time Numbers – trace, count and colour 1 to 10</li>
<li>Bedtime Letters – trace A to Z with a picture to colour for every letter</li>
<li>Personalised name page, certificate and reward stickers</li>
</ul>
Green start dots and arrows show where to begin. Best with chunky crayons. For ages 2–4 with a grown-up.
